text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER fired -> PagerDuty P12345: High 5xx error rate detected on inference-gateway (us-west1). 5m avg 5xx = 8.6% (threshold 2%). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Links: https://pagerduty.example/P12345, https://grafana.example/d/inference/5xx?orgId=1

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert created: P12345. Escalation policy: inference-oncall.

sre-oncall: acked the PD. I'm on it — starting quick triage. Can someone grab logs for kv-cache and gateway proxies?

alice.m: grabbing logs now. Early look: lots of "kv_cache_eviction: OOM" and "upstream response 502" from kvcache sidecar around 00:02 UTC. Pushing a tail of logs:
```
2024-12-15T00:02:18Z ERROR kv_cache_eviction: current_mem=9728MB limit=8192MB
2024-12-15T00:02:19Z WARN  inference-proxy upstream_response=502 route=/v1/generate req_id=abc123
```

bob-dev: is this correlated with the rollout we did ~23:50? The canary had a new kv policy. If kvcache is OOM-ing, we should reduce traffic to us-west1 and route to us-east1 while we investigate.

sre-oncall: agree. Initiating traffic weight shift. routing set: us-west1 -> 10%, us-east1 -> 90%. Applying now.

incident-bot: routing change applied by infra-runbook: service routing weights updated (us-west1:10%, us-east1:90%).

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% in 60s. latency stable. still seeing some 502s for connections that hit older kv cache processes.

alice.m: continuing log dig. I see repeated GC/eviction spikes on kvcache pods that haven't restarted. Many pods show memory pressure and heap grow spikes.

bob-dev: rolling a restart for kvcache pods in us-west1 (one-by-one) to recover memory and re-populate KV prefixes. Triggering controlled restarts now.

carol-support: FYI — CS notified preliminary impact: several customers reported intermittent 502s in last 15 minutes. No data loss reported. Creating internal incident ticket and outbound status update draft.

sre-oncall: restarts in progress, traffic already shifted. After first few restarts 5xx dropped under 1% across global. Good signal. Will keep routing at 90/10 until stable for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: P12345 status: acknowledged by sre-oncall.

alice.m: quick root-cause hypothesis: new kv eviction behavior in recent canary triggers aggressive memory reclaim under certain workload patterns (long-tail seq lengths). We need a rollback of the kv policy change in the canary and a postmortem.

bob-dev: agreed. Rolling back kv policy change in canary and will schedule a patch to add a memory headroom config.

sre-oncall: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and coordinate postmortem. Leaving the PD open for now and will resolve once traffic restored to normal and kvcache restarts stable. Estimated next update in 20m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: alert suppression note: multiple duplicate autopagers fired during the evictions. Recommend tuning suppression window for kv-cache-derived 5xx alerts to avoid alert storm next time.

carol-support: putting an external status note in draft: "We experienced elevated 502 errors affecting some customers in us-west1. Root cause under investigation; mitigation in place via traffic reroute. No data loss. Updates to follow."

sre-oncall: final note for now — mitigation successful, 5xx now ~0.6% globally. Keeping reduced weight on us-west1 and will revert to normal over 30m if stable. Postmortem owners: bob-dev (fix), alice.m (logs/monitoring), me (incident summary).
